title: Prior art, and what novelty is claimed — 9 machine-checked theorems and how they are bound
description:
Prior art, and what novelty is claimed. 9 machine-checked theorems from the Lean 4 source file src/proof/priorart.lean, by Tsvetan Rouschev, licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Lean 4 is a proof checker: a theorem it accepts has been checked by its kernel, not argued in prose. All are checked case by case over a stated finite domain (by decide). Every theorem listed is sealed live in the deposit's ledger, where a withdrawal is marked in place; 63 earlier rows removed on 2026-08-09 are listed in src/proof/revoked.json.

How these theorems are bound. "Entangled" is used here in a precise, non-quantum sense: theorems are bound when they derive from shared definitions (section 1), when their files import one another (section 2), and when their content-addressed receipts fold into one address that changes if any one of them changes (section 3). It is correlation by derivation; no information travels through it.

1 · Shared definitions. 3 definitions are used by two or more theorems, binding 72 pairs; the theorems fall into 1 strand. Most binding: sources (9), kindOf (7), novelty (6).

2 · Imports. Built on: no other cluster. Built on it: no other cluster. Checking this cluster needs 1 file: src/proof/priorart.lean.

3 · The joint address. The 9 sealed receipts fold to dce2284f-5e64-85d5-92f0-c6bc93b315b9. Order-invariant: yes — the same root in reverse order. Altering one receipt changes it: yes, computed when this record was generated. A content-address proves integrity, not truth.

4 · The address lattice. Each theorem sits at the seven ray values its page plots from its receipt, taken mod 9: a point of (ℤ/9)⁷. This cluster's centre is (2, 4, 5, 3, 4, 7, 4). Its nearest clusters, ranked by lift — pairs counted from this cluster's theorems' seven nearest points, over the pairs expected by chance from the two clusters' sizes: involution.lean (3 observed, 0.62 expected, lift 4.86), energy.lean (5 observed, 2.16 expected, lift 2.31), mechanical.lean (13 observed, 9.81 expected, lift 1.33). A best lift is the largest of about 32 small ratios, so chance alone gives a typical best lift of 3.24 here (the median over 200 seeded reshufflings of which cluster each point belongs to); one at least as high as this cluster's arose in 11.0% of them — consistent with chance. Mean distance between two of its theorems: 14.92; from one of its theorems to a theorem of another cluster: 15.45. A receipt is a hash, so nearness on this lattice is a property of the addresses, not of the mathematics; the mathematical binding is (1) and (2). These figures are as of commit 78375f1a602d (2026-09-15), over 817 points; a new seal anywhere moves them.

Prior art. THE PRACTICE IS PRIOR ART AND IS CREDITED. Recording provenance and attribution per artefact is long established and formalised: W3C PROV-O, the DataCite metadata schema, Dublin Core Metadata Terms, PREMIS for archived digital objects, the Open Provenance Model, and the software citation principles' credit-and-attribution requirement. Nothing about keeping an attribution table is new, and this deposit does not suggest otherwise. Per-theorem prior-art searches — OEIS, zbMATH Open, OpenAlex, Crossref, arXiv — are recorded, with what was searched, where and when, in the living ledger src/proof/novelty.json (main branch). No novelty is claimed here.

The theorems.

  1. novelty_is_claimed_only_where_a_search_was_performed — sources.all (fun s => novelty s == false || kindOf s == 2) record
  2. this_deposit_claims_no_novelty_today — (sources.filter novelty).length = 0 record
  3. the_restated_sources_are_named_and_claim_nothing — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 0)).all (fun s => novelty s == false) record
  4. an_unsearched_source_claims_nothing — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).all (fun s => novelty s == false) record
  5. every_source_is_classified — sources.all (fun s => kindOf s == 0 || kindOf s == 1 || kindOf s == 2) record
  6. the_kinds_cover_every_source — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 0)).length + (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).length + (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 2)).length = sources.length record
  7. some_sources_are_unsearched — (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).length > 0 record
  8. zero_claims_is_not_full_attribution — (sources.filter novelty).length = 0 ∧ (sources.filter (fun s => kindOf s == 1)).length > 0 record
  9. novelty_is_claimed_of_no_source — (sources.filter novelty).length = 0 record
